title: Beatrix and the Winter
author: Odile Nystrom
blurb: Zephyrine Ravensworth, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
